searchText: Hey all. Looking for threshold support. I have been lurking and learning as suggested and would appreciate being specifically tasked to earn any help or guidance to where I could best participate. try inverting that. handing out tasks isn't exactly how this work. find a project you are interested in, figure out how you are able to contribute and add value, ask specific questions when you've done your homework and still can't figure something out.
